newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil official to leave company.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil official to leave company.

text.p: Pennzoil Co said Thomas M. Hamilton, who joined the company in December 1991 with a five-year commitment to oversee the restructuring of the company's oil and natural gas operations, is leaving to pursue other interests.
Hamilton will continue with the company as a consultant through the end of 1997, it said.
A new head of Pennzoil's exploration and production company is expected to be named soon.
Pennzoil said it has an active drilling program scheduled for 1997.

Domestically, the company plans to drill seven exploration wells in the Gulf of Mexico. International exploration drilling will also accelerate in 1997, with a total of seven wells to be drilled in Azerbaijan, Egypt and Qatar.
